dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Symmetrical geometric narrowing of the visible 2D silhouette from the mid-section toward the posterior terminus.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Continuous smooth edges with a subtle outward curve on the right mid-lateral boundary.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: High-intensity grayscale baseline consistent with a white surface, featuring localized specular highlights along the right side of the dorsal ridge.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency clusters of darker grey pixels localized along the central longitudinal axis and increasing in density toward the posterior region.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Soft, diffuse gradients between the primary white surface and darker grey-toned regions.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Multiple faint, parallel vertical linear marks of slightly lower pixel intensity on the upper left quadrant of the dorsal surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct linear contrast disruptions on the upper left dorsal region.
